newsitem.title: UK: UK Ecu 3-month bills highest yield falls.
newsitem.headline: UK Ecu 3-month bills highest yield falls.

text.p: The highest accepted yield at Tuesday's auction of 500 million Ecu of three-month bills fell to 3.99 percent from last month's 4.06 percent, the Bank of England said.
That compares with an average yield of 3.98 percent, the BoE said.
The highest yield accepted for the 200 million Ecu of one month bills fell to 3.99 percent from 4.04 percent, and compared with an average yield of 3.99 percent.
The auction of 300 million Ecu of six-month bills, produced a highest accepted yield of 3.98 percent, down from 4.05 percent last month, and against an average yield of 3.97 percent.
The three-part tender totalling one billion Ecu met applications of 3.06 billion Ecu and was allotted in full.
As announced in its tender notice dated December 3 the Bank took an additional 50 million of bills onto its own books, for use in adding liquidity through sale and repurchase agreements.
The next Ecu tender will be on January 14, 1997, the Bank said. Details will be released on January 7.
